description: List the DIDs that put a given book on one of their shelves.

bookUri.description: AT-URI of the catalog book whose shelvers to list.

limit.description: Maximum number of distinct DIDs to return.

bookUri.description: The book the DIDs shelved, echoed from the request.

dids.description: Distinct DIDs in `min(uri)` order. Every uri starts with `at://<did>/…`, so this is lexicographic DID order — which is what makes the keyset cursor strict.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor; absent when no further DIDs are known.
